scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const f=require('node:fs');f.existsSync('assets')?f.cpSync('assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true}):console.warn('[build] assets/ 不存在,跳过拷贝(托盘图标将由源码内嵌副本兜底)')"
scripts.probe:sqlite: pnpm --filter @sct/server build && pnpm run build && electron dist/probes/sqlite.js
